## Why This Is Asked

- Contract tests between perception, planning, control
- Simulation-based testing (CARLA)
- Fault injection and latency/packet-loss chaos

## Code Example

```javascript
// Example: simple drift detector stub
function driftScore(pastDist, currentDist) {

}
```

questions.explanation:
## Testing Strategy

### Unit Tests
- Test controller logic in isolation
- Mock external dependencies (database, email service)
- Verify input validation and error handling

### Integration Tests
- Test full request-response cycle
- Use test containers or in-memory database
- Verify database operations and constraints

### Test Cases
- Valid user creation (201 status)
- Invalid email format (400 status)
- Duplicate email (409 status)
- Database connection error (500 status)
- Missing required fields (400 status)

### Tools
- Jest/Mocha for test framework
- Supertest for HTTP assertions
- Testcontainers for database integration
